visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white woodcut-style engraving depicting a tranquil, marshy landscape at dusk or dawn. In the foreground, a person wearing a wide-brimmed hat lies prone on the ground, observing a shallow body of water. Another figure, dressed in traditional East Asian-style robes and a cap, stands on the left bank looking toward the water. Several long-legged birds, resembling cranes or herons, are wading in the water. A small wooden structure on stilts stands on the left, and a path leads into the distance where a small, indistinct figure is walking. The scene is framed by dense trees and foliage, with birds flying in the sky.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Trees, foliage, marshy water, wooden structure on stilts, long-legged birds (cranes/herons), path, sky with birds, rocks.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: A person lying prone in the foreground wearing a wide-brimmed hat; a standing figure in traditional East Asian-style robes and a cap; a small, distant figure walking on a path.
